nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
资产角色：
<Picture 1>
国风动漫少女，深棕色发髻点缀红梅与蝶形发饰，身穿白金红相间的抹胸上衣与飘逸薄纱灯笼裤，周身环绕金红流光与炽炎花瓣特效。
<Picture 2>
硬派白发战将，身穿暗红色皮革长款风衣、黑色内衬与战术皮裤，手持重剑与双枪，周身散发冷冽红黑魔力气浪。

一个低机位推近镜头框住
<Picture 1>
与
<Picture 2>
在废墟长廊两端对峙。
<Picture 1>
率先启动超音速贴地冲刺，足尖踏出金红烈焰莲华，甩出赤红绫缎如游龙贯空；
the camera cuts to
侧面跟摇特写，
<Picture 2>
拔出重剑横向重劈，刀锋与炽炎绫缎剧烈碰撞，火星与雷光四向迸射，气浪撕裂地面石板。
the shot transitions to
俯冲环绕镜头，
<Picture 1>
借力凌空翻腾，双掌结印召唤暴雨般金红火蝶与符文剑气垂直轰炸；
<Picture 2>
单手举剑格挡，魔力红光护盾展开，随即甩动红风衣滑步侧移，拔枪极速连射，火舌与剑气在半空接连引爆。
the camera dynamically follows
贴地高速滑移，
<Picture 1>
在弹雨残影中多维瞬闪，瞬身突进至
<Picture 2>
身前旋身横扫，赤焰气刃斩开风衣下摆；
the shot changes to
极速下坠定点特写，
<Picture 2>
反手抽刀上挑震开攻击，
<Picture 1>
空中旋身单手撑地滑退数米，
<Picture 1>
与
<Picture 2>
同时稳住身形横刃相对，周身烈火与魔能疯狂暴涨，在最强杀意临界点定格。
overall_soundscape: Explosive shockwaves crack the stone ground as steel clashes with fiery energy ribbons. Gunfire roars in rapid bursts followed by the sizzling hum of burning petals and swirling demonic aura.non_diegetic_music: High-octane heavy metal hybrid with aggressive electric guitar riffs, pounding industrial drums, and intense symphonic brass, cutting off sharply on the final clash.

- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
